about: Four-player split screen (docs/split4.md), applied by regen.sh (tools.recomp --relocate, toolkit tools/recomp/relocate.py). Each entry moves one of the title's fixed two-slot player arrays into the block the runtime reserves right after the image (src/game/split4.c, 0x00780000 for the USA executable): every immediate and displacement inside [lo, hi) becomes to + (v - lo); with base, also a register-relative displacement in [lo - base, hi - base); a cmp against hi (a loop's end) becomes to + size. The targets must match src/game/split4.h.

relocations.name: humans
relocations.note: The race world's human racers (world 0x60EA00 + 0x12B7D0, stride 0x27E0, two slots; the AI racers follow at + 0x130790). Built by sub_001AACB0 from the stage's player count, constructed (vtable 0x3B11A0) by sub_001A9930. Four slots of 0x27E0.
